description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Organizations class, which manages organization data within the application. It includes methods for creating organizations, finding organizations by name, and checking name availability, utilizing Moose and Catalyst frameworks.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Organizations
classes.description: A Moose-based Catalyst model class for managing organization entities, including creation, lookup, and name validation functionalities.

methods.name: ACCEPT_CONTEXT
methods.description: Sets the schema attribute for the current request context, allowing access to database operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new organization with specified attributes, ensuring the name is unique and associating an owner user.

methods.name: find_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves an organization record by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: name_available
methods.description: Checks if a given name is available for use, not used by users or organizations, and not blacklisted.
